title: Case 043: Washing Machine Repair Request
initial_request:
Washing machine not draining any water 

Have manually drained by removing filter. Have also cleaned the filter. Still the drum is not draining.
overview: The tenant reported that the washing machine was not draining, even after manually draining it and cleaning the filter. Northbridge Lettings arranged for Oakfield Homes to attend, with the landlord approving a simple, low-cost repair and asking to be contacted for approval if parts or more complex work were needed. The provider confirmed the repair was completed on November 4th; Northbridge Lettings later told the landlord that the drain-pipe propeller had been re-fitted and the washing machine re-installed. The request was closed after the checks were completed.
outcome: The washing machine repair was completed: the drain-pipe propeller was re-fitted and the washing machine re-installed. The request was closed.
